title: Stationfall: First Steps
summary: Set up the first safe Stationfall loop before widening the route.

blocks.title: Start Small
blocks.body: Carry oxygen, a seal kit, a panic counter if available, food, and a clearly marked exit before treating the station as a salvage site.

blocks.title: First Clean Win
blocks.body: A first station run should end before reserves feel dramatic: oxygen checked, pressure tools packed, exit marked, and one objective completed.

blocks.title: Before You Expand
blocks.body: Name the goal, the exit, and the resource or signal that proves Stationfall is helping. If any of those are vague, keep the next run shorter.

blocks.title: Ready Check
blocks.body: Before moving on, confirm the first setup step is repeatable and safe enough to do again.
